load_locomotion_gym_env: load a pre-defined locomotion gym environment using gin config files and return the env instance
load_multiagent_env: load a multiagent mobility gym environment by passing multiagent=True to the load function
load_env_with_wrappers: load a gym environment wrapped with user-provided wrapper classes like TrajectoryGeneratorWrapperEnv
bind_robot_params: bind robot configuration parameters to gin by passing robot_params kwargs to the load function
bind_task_params: bind task configuration parameters to gin by passing task_params kwargs to the load function
